The Alpha-1 Antitrypsin level is normal, which helps rule out that specific genetic cause. Have you ever been hospitalized for asthma, or do you have a history of allergic rhinitis and eczema?

Also, does your shortness of breath improve significantly after taking a rescue inhaler?

speaker: Doctor
text: That normal FeNO level makes an active allergic asthma component less likely. Have you noticed any blood streaks in your sputum, or have you been exposed to second-hand smoke or vaping recently?

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD), likely exacerbated by a history of smoking.
